anomalies.observed: C46 is valued 22pF, but its MPN CC0603KRX7R0BB223 is a 22nF part ("223" code). Its three sister Bob Smith termination capacitors C42, C44 and C45 are all 22nF on the same 0603 footprint, so C46 is about 1000x too small.
anomalies.expected: A 22nF 100V capacitor (matching C42, C44, C45 and the MPN) so the CAN/Ethernet-style termination network on VC1 is symmetric and filters the centre-tap noise as intended.

evidence.quote: C46 | 22pF 100v | Capacitor_SMD:C_0603_1608Metric | Device:C | Unpolarized capacitor | LCSC=C313105, MPN=CC0603KRX7R0BB223, Manufacturer=YAGEO
C42 | 22nF 100v | Capacitor_SMD:C_0603_1608Metric | Device:C | Unpolarized capacitor | LCSC=C313105, MPN=CC0603KRX7R0BB223, Manufacturer=YAGEO

anomalies.impact: The VC1 termination leg has roughly 1000x less capacitance than its three neighbours, so the Bob Smith-style termination is unbalanced. Common-mode noise on that leg is filtered poorly, which can degrade Ethernet emissions and immunity.

anomalies.observed: R36 is valued 24k, but its MPN FRC0805J240TSD encodes 240 (24 ohm) in the usual three-digit code.
anomalies.expected: A 24k resistor, if the MPN is correct, or a 24-ohm part if the value is correct. The two fields should agree.

evidence.quote: R36 | 24k | Resistor_SMD:R_0805_2012Metric | Device:R | Resistor | Digikey=RMCF0805FT750RCT-ND, LCSC=C2930261, MPN=FRC0805J240TSD, Manufacturer=FOJAN

anomalies.impact: If the part really is 24 ohms, it would load the VOUTP/VOUTN supercap bank heavily and draw large current, which would matter a great deal on this supply rail.

anomalies.observed: The LTC4412 PowerPath P-FET Q1 has its source (Q1.2) on the +5V output rail and its drain (Q1.3) on USBC_VBUS_IN, which is the USB input. U6.1 VIN is on USBC_VBUS_IN and U6.6 SENSE is on +5V.
anomalies.expected: In the LTC4412 ideal-diode arrangement the P-FET source should sit on the input supply (VIN, USB) and its drain on the sensed load (SENSE, +5V). The orientation appears reversed.

evidence.quote: Q1 | Q_PMOS_GSD | Package_TO_SOT_SMD:SOT-23 | Device:Q_PMOS_GSD | P-MOSFET transistor, gate/source/drain
USBC_VBUS_IN [High Power] : ... Q1.3(D,passive) R11.1(passive) R64.2(2,passive) U25.5(VBUS,passive) U6.1(VIN,power_in)

anomalies.impact: The body diode of Q1 would point the wrong way for USB-to-+5V conduction, so the USB power path may not work as intended. The spec already notes that the USB power path is an open issue.

parsed.summary: The most likely anomaly is C46, which is valued 22pF while its MPN and the three sister termination capacitors (C42, C44, C45) are 22nF, making the VC1 termination leg about 1000x too small. Two lower-confidence concerns are the R36 value versus its MPN and the reversed source/drain orientation of the LTC4412 P-FET Q1.
